_comment_purpose: OPT-IN replacement for tmbilling-api.json that makes `pm2 reload` a REAL 0-downtime
handover. Not the shipped default — switching costs a one-time pm2 id renumbering
Measured on this codebase, hammering /healthz sequentially through one `pm2 reload`:
pm2 only does a rolling handover for cluster_mode: God.reloadProcessId (lib/God/
Reload.js) falls through to restartProcessId for anything else, so a fork app gets a
stop-then-start no matter which verb you type.
_comment_script: `src/server.ts`, NOT `src/index.ts`. index.ts auto-starts only when it owns argv[1],
and under pm2's cluster wrapper argv[1] is pm2's own ProcessContainer.js — measured:
the app loads, logs nothing, listens on nothing, and pm2 still reports it online with
zero restarts. server.ts calls start() outright.
`node_args` MUST be an ARRAY. ClusterMode.js line 36 is
"--import tsx" is silently ignored, which loses the TypeScript loader with no error.
This does NOT reintroduce the launcher bug the other configs warn about: in cluster
mode pm2 forks the worker itself and requires the app in-process, so the pid pm2
tracks is the pid running the app. Verified: pgrep -P on it is empty.
`node_args` loads deploy/pm2/tsx-preload.mjs by ABSOLUTE path: a cluster child starts in the
pm2 daemon's cwd, so a bare `--import tsx` (and tsx's tsconfig lookup) resolved from wherever
the daemon was launched — the worker's first cluster switch crash-looped on it (2026-09-27).
name: tmbilling-api
_comment_instances: 2 is the minimum that buys anything: a rolling reload needs one instance still serving
while the other restarts. More is available capacity, not more billing throughput — the
clock is a separate process and is single-flight by construction.
Two instances are safe for the two pieces of state the API keeps, both checked rather
than assumed: rate-limit counters live in Postgres (platform/rate-limit.ts is all
db.execute), so a second instance does not double anyone's allowance; and ops_http_stats
has no unique index while its reader ACCUMULATES (`acc.requests += r.requests`, buckets
merged), so two processes flushing the same (process, minute, route) cell sum correctly

Do it during a window; the delete is a real stop.
